hurts.line: I don't care if it hurts
stanza: I don't care if it hurts
I wanna have control
I wanna perfect body
I wanna perfect soul
I want you to know this
I'm not around
So very special
I wish I was special
You do it to yourself, you do
And that's what really hurts
Is that you do it to yourself, just you
You and no one else
You do it to yourself
You do it to yourself

hurts.line: You'll never know how much it hurts
stanza: You'll never know how much it hurts
To see you sit and cry
You know you need and want my love
Yet you're afraid to try
Why do you run and hide from life?
To try it just ain't smart
Why can't I free your doubtful mind
And melt your cold, cold heart?

hurts.line: I call in sick to work, I tell ‘em my whole body hurts

I call in sick to work, I tell ‘em my whole body hurts
Yeah, I think this drinkin' just might be the death of me
The man down at the meeting says we need to work this out
We need to talk about our problems, if we got ‘em
I think I've got a drinkin' problem

hurts.line: And it hurts, and it hurts
stanza: And it hurts, and it hurts
But I don't wanna talk about it
Don't speak
I know just what you're thinking
So please stop explaining
Don't tell me 'cause it hurts
